name: Viaduct
soft_passes: #1 mask discipline: fits an iOS superellipse but bakes the mask, edge-rim light, specular and drop shadow (non-native authoring)
#7 figure-ground: lit upper glyph >3:1 on black, but shadowed lower piers (#32615E/#295D5F) dip to ~2.5:1 against the darkest bottom field
#9 era coherence: internally consistent but Big Sur construction quoting Liquid-Glass materiality as a baked raster
failures: #10 variant robustness: baked flat raster, transparent corners, no separable Icon Composer layers — dark field can't invert and teal can't recolor for dark/clear/tinted variants

palette.background: ramp #313131->#131313 (near-black charcoal, baked top-left edge rim #5D5D5D-#9F9F9F)
palette.accent: none (teal glyph is the only hue)

light_model: top-down; baked specular catch (#BFFCF4) on the lintel top face and arch crown, undersides fall to #295D5F; glyph casts a soft baked ambient-occlusion shadow onto the near-black field; the arch opening is a modeled dark recess (tunnel/passage)
layer_stack: baked squircle mask + baked edge-rim light
teal-glass viaduct: two piers + arched opening + horizontal lintel beam, beveled top faces
baked specular catch + inner-arch recess shadow
devices: literal-monument glyph (app named Viaduct drawn as a viaduct/aqueduct arch)
teal-glass extrusion with beveled top faces and a bright specular catch
dark-field spotlight (single luminous object on a near-black shelf)
modeled inner-arch recess reading as a passage/tunnel
rhymes_hint: dark-field glowing-object utility/dev-tool icons that spotlight one glassy luminous object on near-black (rather than a light Big Sur squircle); extruded-3D-object-on-black family and literal-monument/architecture glyphs; palette-family rhyme is teal/viridian glass ramps
notes: 256x256 web render, not the 1024 master (SHA-1 cdabed8d) — bevel/specular/recess judged from a downscaled raster, edge treatment (estimated) not (measured). Corners are transparent (alpha 0): ships pre-masked as an iOS superellipse with baked edge-rim, baked specular (#BFFCF4) and baked drop shadow — an iOS App Store icon reused on Mac, violating HIG 'provide unmasked square layers; let the system apply effects'. That baking is exactly why #10 fails (no separable layers). Palette coheres with the cover (teal/viridian brand hue ~#0D9488 family + dark UI window). Glyph slightly heavy/large but within safe zone. Checks 1-4 all clear.
